verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 comes with an official software ecosystem (NVIDIA app, Project G-Assist, CUDA Toolkit), so an official MCP server for controlling or querying the GPU is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an NVIDIA MCP server. G-Assist is an assistant rather than an MCP endpoint, and the llms.txt probe is an adjacent docs feature, so neither earns credit.
